changed_model_inputs: Fold training rows: saved eligible training rows restricted by nominal_decision_at to the preceding 365 days
One common weight multiplier per fold preserves original total sample-weight mass
challenger.name: RECENT365

data.dataset_construction: Construct one LightGBM Dataset per fold from only that fold's RECENT365 training rows, labels, and scaled weights; validation rows do not contribute to Dataset bin construction.
data.purge: Reuse each saved train/validation index pair; retain the existing label-availability purge, then apply the 365-day inclusive lower bound using nominal_decision_at only.
data.window_boundary: [first_validation_nominal_decision_at - 365 days, first_validation_nominal_decision_at), UTC; lower bound based on information/decision time, not label completion.

economics.policy: Existing independent fixed-$5, net-EV >= 1%, T-60 decision/T-59 execution engine, fees, depth and cutoff.

specification.hypothesis: Restricting model training to recent information may reduce obsolete-history effects; this experiment does not assume improvement.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap over shared UTC calendar days
